title: gentle-shell-PR roadmap
brief: A compact pull request rail paired with progressive read-only inspector tabs, growing from focused metadata to broader review and operational context.

artboards.title: v0.2 · Focused PR detail
artboards.tradeoff: Adds Overview, Checks, and metadata-only Files tabs while preserving the compact rail and Gentle Shell's existing diff workflow.

artboards.title: v0.3 · Review and issue context
artboards.tradeoff: Speeds up diagnosis with issues, threads, and failed logs, at the cost of a denser panel.

artboards.title: v0.4 · Merge workflow timeline
artboards.tradeoff: Provides complete post-merge visibility but requires a taller, scroll-oriented sidebar.

artboards.title: v0.5 · Multi-repository command center
artboards.tradeoff: Maximizes operational visibility across repos, agents, and ODD work while introducing the most complexity and distraction.
